summary: A16 opened inputs/flawed-report.png, measured it with four pixel probes and cross-checked every observable problem against inputs/source.csv, the sole trusted data. Eight problems were documented in findings.json with image location, phenomenon, source check, impact, correction and final viewing result - 2 numeric (profit card Q3 printed 42 against a computed 32; the title claimed Q3 has the highest profit when Q4 leads at 54), 3 falsified claims (副标题 said revenue rises continuously while Q3 falls 7万元, the callout recommended concentrating on Q3, and the legend declared 蓝=成本/橙=收入 while the blue bars carry the revenue column), 2 geometric (axis truncated at 100 with both the zero line and two data points off-scale, and eight bars drawn at 1.222..1.547 px per 万元 = a 26.6% spread with no shared scale), and 1 traceability gap; three further observations that only data cannot falsify (palette, legend order, label placement) were recorded separately as confirmed_error=false. The corrected report was regenerated from source.csv with a common zero baseline at 1.4 px per 万元 and re-rendered three times: v01 fixed wording, alignment and a redundant rule after viewing, v02 added white label backplates so gridlines stop crossing the digits, and v03 is the deliverable. Final state: 16 iteration rows with 2 complete visual iterations, 4 defects found by actually opening the images, 3 measurement passes all passing (5 gridlines 70 px apart, all 8 bar bottoms on the zero line, px/万元 spread 0.30% against the input's 26.6%, axis read-back max error 0.29 万元, 12 text lines with at least 29 px of right padding), an independent viewer transcribing all six zoom crops against source.csv with no discrepancy, and the delivered PNG reopened at full size. 4 requests (3 render + 1 document, all HTTP 200, 0 failed, 0 retried, 0 rate-limited), 16547.4 ms of request time, 8 image views in this session plus 6 by the independent viewer.
